name: GNOME Pomodoro
description:
GNOME Pomodoro is a time management and productivity tool implementing the Pomodoro Technique. It helps maintain focus and prevent mental burnout by structuring work into timed intervals separated by short restorative breaks.

Features:
- Visual timer with customizable work intervals, short breaks, and long breaks
- Desktop notifications and subtle screen dimming reminders during breaks
- Detailed productivity statistics and daily work session history
- Audio chimes and custom sound effects for interval transitions
- Clean desktop interface integrating seamlessly with modern Linux environments
